newsitem.title: USA: Bomb scare clears Pennsylvania shopping center.
newsitem.headline: Bomb scare clears Pennsylvania shopping center.

text.p: A firebomb planted in the kitchen of an Italian restaurant forced the evacuation of a suburban shopping centre Thursday, police said.
More than 100 stores in the Chesterbrook Shopping Centre were evacuated for hours while the Philadelphia police bomb squad removed the device from Marcello's Restaurant.

The device was described as a detonator surrounded by three gallons of gasoline, attached to a natural gas line feeding the restaurant stove. It had not detonated only because a wire connecting it to a power source had fallen out.
"Somebody was trying to hurt people. This had the power to do a lot of damage," said Captain Paul Pennybrook of the Tredyffrin Township police, who were looking for whoever planted the device.
